title: Goa Tour - Beaches, Sunsets & Nightlife
overview: Experience the vibrant beauty of Goa with this 3 Nights / 4 Days TripWithMe group tour starting from Indore. Travel by train and explore Goa's stunning beaches, historic forts, Portuguese heritage, scenic viewpoints, and lively nightlife. Visit popular attractions like Baga Beach, Calangute Beach, Fort Aguada, Chapora Fort, and the Basilica of Bom Jesus. Enjoy beautiful sunsets, exciting beach experiences, comfortable accommodation, and unforgettable memories with fellow travelers. Package price starts from ₹7,000 per person, subject to final travel arrangements and inclusions.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa & Evening Dinner Cruise
activities: Arrival at Goa Airport or Railway Station and transfer to hotel.
Check-in and freshen up.
Visit Dona Paula Viewpoint (Subject to Arrival Time).
Explore Miramar Beach and enjoy scenic coastal views.
Explore Panjim local market or Fontainhas Latin Quarter (Time Permitting).
Enjoy Mandovi River Dinner Cruise with music, entertainment and scenic river views (Subject to Availability).
Return to hotel.
Dinner and overnight stay in Goa.

itinerary.title: North Goa Beaches & Fort Sightseeing
activities: Breakfast at hotel.
Visit Fort Aguada and explore its historic lighthouse.
Visit Candolim Beach and enjoy beautiful coastal views.
Explore Calangute Beach, one of Goa's most popular beaches.
Visit Baga Beach and enjoy beachside cafés and shopping.
Explore Anjuna Beach and its scenic surroundings.
Visit Chapora Fort and enjoy panoramic views of the Arabian Sea.
Optional water sports and beach activities (Self Paid & Subject to Availability).
Return to hotel.
Dinner and overnight stay in Goa.

itinerary.title: South Goa Heritage & Beach Sightseeing
activities: Breakfast at hotel.
Visit Basilica of Bom Jesus, a famous historic church in Old Goa.
Explore Se Cathedral and the heritage churches of Old Goa.
Visit Shri Mangueshi Temple and admire its traditional architecture.
Enjoy scenic views at Dona Paula Viewpoint (If Not Covered on Day 1).
Visit Colva Beach and enjoy leisure time by the sea.
Explore local markets for shopping (Time Permitting).
Return to hotel.
Dinner and overnight stay in Goa.

itinerary.title: Departure from Goa
activities: Breakfast at hotel.
Check-out from hotel.
Enjoy a short beach visit or local shopping (Time Permitting).
Transfer to Goa Airport or Railway Station.
Tour Ends with Beautiful Memories of Goa.

inclusions: North Goa Sightseeing as per Itinerary
South Goa Sightseeing as per Itinerary
exclusions: GST (If Not Included in Package Price)

thingsToCarry.title: Lightweight Clothing
thingsToCarry.description: Carry comfortable cotton clothes, beachwear and breathable outfits suitable for Goa's warm and humid weather.

thingsToCarry.title: Comfortable Footwear
thingsToCarry.description: Carry sandals, flip-flops and comfortable walking shoes for beaches and sightseeing.

thingsToCarry.title: Identity Proof
thingsToCarry.description: Carry a valid government-issued photo ID for hotel check-in and travel verification.

thingsToCarry.title: Personal Medicines
thingsToCarry.description: Carry your regular medicines, basic first-aid essentials and any necessary prescriptions.

thingsToCarry.title: Beach Essentials
thingsToCarry.description: Carry swimwear, a quick-dry towel, a waterproof phone pouch and a change of clothes for beach activities.

thingsToCarry.title: Sunscreen & Sunglasses
thingsToCarry.description: Carry sunscreen, sunglasses and a hat or cap to protect yourself from the sun.

thingsToCarry.title: Rain Protection
thingsToCarry.description: Carry a compact umbrella or light raincoat, especially when travelling during the monsoon season.

thingsToCarry.title: Power Bank & Chargers
thingsToCarry.description: Carry your phone charger and a power bank to keep your devices charged during sightseeing.

thingsToKnow.title: Weather
thingsToKnow.description: Goa generally has a warm and humid climate. Carry light clothing and stay hydrated throughout the trip.

thingsToKnow.title: Beach Safety
thingsToKnow.description: Follow lifeguard instructions, observe beach warning flags and avoid swimming in restricted areas or rough seas.

thingsToKnow.title: Optional Activities
thingsToKnow.description: Water sports, adventure activities and the Mandovi River Dinner Cruise may require additional payment unless specifically included in the package.

thingsToKnow.title: Hotel Stay
thingsToKnow.description: The package includes 3 nights of hotel accommodation, subject to the confirmed hotel category and booking terms.

thingsToKnow.title: Sightseeing Schedule
thingsToKnow.description: North Goa and South Goa sightseeing are planned according to the itinerary. Actual coverage may vary depending on traffic, weather and available time.

thingsToKnow.title: Arrival & Departure
thingsToKnow.description: Airport or railway station pickup and drop are provided according to the confirmed package and travel timings.

thingsToKnow.title: Local Transport
thingsToKnow.description: Vehicle allocation depends on group size and the selected package. Additional transfers outside the itinerary may incur extra charges.

thingsToKnow.title: Responsible Tourism
thingsToKnow.description: Respect local customs, keep beaches clean and follow rules at temples, churches and other tourist attractions.

importantNotes.text: Booking amount is non-refundable once confirmed.
The itinerary may change due to weather, road conditions or government regulations.
Gondola Ride, Pony Ride and other optional activities are subject to availability.
Please cooperate with the Tour Captain and respect local culture and environment.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.content: If cancellations are made 60-30 days before the trip's start date, 10% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made 30 days before the trip's start date, 50% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made within 0-30 days before the trip's start date, 100% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. In case of unforeseen weather conditions or government restrictions, certain activities may be canceled, and in such cases, the operator will try his best to provide an alternate feasible activity. However, no refund will be provided for the same.

policies.title: Booking Policy
policies.content: Book your seats by depositing an advance of 50% per head to the below account and the rest has to be paid 1 day prior to the time of departure of the trip. Send Payment screenshot on the below numbers. And fill out the form which will be provided by us. Then booking will confirm accordingly.If you want to book any specific seat in the traveler then you have to pay Rs.300/- extra amount for booking specific seat number, (seats will be provided subject to availability basis)/ First come first basis.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.content: Your personal data is secure with us and only used for booking and communication purposes. We never share data with third parties.

policies.title: Travel & Safety Policy
policies.content: We prioritize traveler safety and follow all government-issued travel advisories and guidelines.

policies.title: Late Arrival Policy
policies.content: Participants arriving late may not be eligible for refunds or adjustments. Please arrive 15 minutes early.

policies.title: Group Size Policy
policies.content: Some packages have a maximum group size limit. Please check the Group Size section for details.

policies.title: Travel Insurance Policy
policies.content: While not mandatory, we highly recommend travel insurance for safety and peace of mind during your trip.

policies.title: Prohibited Substances Policy
policies.content: TripWithMe strictly prohibits the use of narcotics, banned substances, weapons, fireworks, or toxic materials during tours. Violation may result in immediate removal without refund and possible legal action.

policies.title: Accommodation Policy
policies.content: The amount given is based on a quad-sharing basis. An extra mattress will be provided for the extra person.

policies.title: Eviction Policy
policies.content: The organizers reserve the right to evict any participant at any time without any refund if their actions violate any tour rules.

policies.title: Safety Outside Premises
policies.content: TripWithMe is not responsible for your safety or whereabouts if you are outside the resort or campsite premises.

policies.title: Damage to Property
policies.content: Any loss or damage to resort or campsite property, such as beds, windows, doors, pillows, or mattresses, will be charged at full replacement cost.

policies.title: Loss or Theft
policies.content: We are not responsible for the loss, theft, or damage of personal belongings during the trip.

policies.title: Health Responsibility
policies.content: TripWithMe is not liable for illnesses, injuries, or health issues that may occur while traveling.

policies.title: ID Requirement
policies.content: All guests must carry a valid government-issued ID card. Outside visitors must be pre-notified to management.

policies.title: Booking Confirmation
policies.content: Slots at the resort or accommodation are confirmed only after receipt of full payment.

policies.title: Injury & Liability
policies.content: Management accepts no responsibility for injuries or the loss/theft of personal property during the tour.

policies.title: Transport Breakdown
policies.content: In case of any transport breakdown during the journey, participants will need to wait until repairs are completed. No backup transport will be provided.

policies.title: Environmental Policy
policies.content: We request all participants to cooperate in keeping the environment clean, safe, and free from litter.

policies.title: Registrations and Tickets Policy
policies.content: Registrations and tickets once booked cannot be exchanged, canceled, or refunded.

policies.title: Event Rules
policies.content: Bonfire, music nights, and other activities are subject to local authority regulations and hotel/campsite policies.

policies.title: Seating Arrangement
policies.content: Seats on buses, tempo travellers, or other vehicles are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

policies.title: Enjoy & Respect
policies.content: Respect fellow travelers, follow all rules, and make the most of your adventure experience.

policies.title: Important Note
policies.content: Numerous factors such as weather conditions, road situations, operational issues, and the physical ability of participants may cause itinerary changes. We reserve the right to modify schedules in the interest of safety, comfort, and the overall wellbeing of participants.

faq.question: Is airfare or train fare included?
faq.answer: No, airfare and train fare to and from Goa are not included in the package.

faq.question: Is the Mandovi River Dinner Cruise included?
faq.answer: The dinner cruise is optional and is not included unless specifically mentioned in your confirmed package.

faq.question: Which places are covered in the Goa package?
faq.answer: The itinerary covers North Goa attractions such as Fort Aguada, Candolim Beach, Calangute Beach, Baga Beach, Anjuna Beach and Chapora Fort, along with selected South Goa attractions such as the Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, Shri Mangueshi Temple and Colva Beach.

faq.question: Is airport or railway station pickup and drop included?
faq.answer: Yes, pickup and drop from Goa Airport or Railway Station are included as per the confirmed package and travel timings.

faq.question: How much advance payment is required?
faq.answer: The advance payment required to confirm your booking depends on the booking terms shared by TripWithMe at the time of reservation.
